summary: Kolibri Global Energy Inc., a TSX- and NASDAQ-listed oil and gas issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 15, 2026 press release providing an operations update on its Tishomingo field wells in Oklahoma. The three Clifton Mack wells (97.45%-99.03% working interest) are producing a combined ~2,100 BOEPD, including ~925 bbl/d oil, with 7%-15% of fracture stimulation fluid recovered; the Lovina 5-8-1HF well awaits flowback. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor or structural change is disclosed. This is a routine operational disclosure, not a special situation; monitor production and flowback results.
